newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London mixed, exporters feature.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London mixed, exporters feature.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mixed on Monday, with selective buying of blue chip exporters after recent weakness being the main feature, dealers said.
Shares in Honda Motors gained 30 yen to close at 3250 yen and Sony Corporation stock rose 22.5 yen to 9682.5 yen.
"Some of the exporters have been weak of late because of the strong yen but a few of them are beginning to look attractive on a valuation basis," said one dealer.
Dealers said trading activity was quiet, with investors content to watch events in Tokyo, where earlier, construction and banking stocks were dogged by concerns over companies with bad debts.
On Friday, Tokai Kogya Co Ltd applied for court protection following problems with loan repayments.
In London, the Nikkei/ISE index fell 22.73 points to close at 1,580.58, after the Nikkei 225 dropped 262.83 to finish at 19,705.17.
